item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 with late goals to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two goals in the final five minutes to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals on Wednesday in Atlanta.

item.title: Spain advances to World Cup final with 2-0 win over France
item.description: Mikel Oyarzabal scored from the penalty spot and Pedro Porro added another goal as Spain beat France 2-0 Tuesday to reach its first World Cup final since 2010.

item.title: Atlanta increases security for England-Argentina World Cup semifinal
item.description: Security and police presence will be increased for Wednesday's England-Argentina World Cup semifinal match in Atlanta due to longstanding tensions between the two nations.

item.title: England and Argentina to renew fierce World Cup rivalry in Atlanta semifinal
item.description: England and Argentina meet in the World Cup semifinals on Wednesday in Atlanta, resuming one of the fiercest rivalries in international soccer.

item.title: World Cup semifinals feature four highest-ranked teams
item.description: The World Cup final four is set with France, Spain, England and Argentina advancing to the semifinals after weekend quarterfinal matches.

item.title: Florida Homeowner Faces Repairs After Hurricane Milton Destroys Roof Two Months After Paying Off Mortgage
item.description: A Florida man paid off his house only to have Hurricane Milton tear off his roof two months later, leaving him to cover repair costs without home insurance.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:

item.description: Adam Chrzan and Tanya Crovo allege their infant son's remains were disturbed during maintenance at Crestlawn Cemetery and reinterred without their knowledge.
